dataset.abstract: A dataset containing all occurrences available in GBIF matching the query: { "and" : [ "Continent is Europe", "Country is Netherlands", "HasCoordinate is true", "HasGeospatialIssue is false", "LifeStage is Adult", "TaxonKey is one of (Noctuidae, Geometridae, Erebidae, Sphingidae)" ] } The dataset includes records from the following constituent datasets. The full metadata for each constituent is also included in this archive: 142 records from Natural History Museum Rotterdam - Specimens 544 records from International Barcode of Life project (iBOL) 4 records from Museum of Comparative Zoology, Harvard University 5 records from Cornell University Insect Collection (CUIC) 4 records from ZMAA Insect collections of Åbo Akademi 137 records from Macro-arthropods survey Drentsche Aa 1996 15 records from Entomologische Sammlung (ETHZ-ENT) of Eidgenössische Technische Hochschule Zürich 17 records from Historic records Stichting Bargerveen 1983-2024 7 records from Lepidoptera World (Luomus) (LEPW) 31219 records from iNaturalist Research-grade Observations 1 records from izeltlabuak.hu observations validated to species level
